{{Quote|Something seemed&hellip; off. Warde stared at us solemnly, speaking little. Suddenly, he came across the table, his lightsaber in hand. He cut down the others. Niot, Petri, Morm&mdash;and me. The others died instantly, I think.|Onrein Hasar describing Warde's actions|<ref name="Chronicles" />}}
'''Niot''' was one of four [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] delegates who met with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Suljo Warde]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Jorra]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]], Niot was one of three of the delegates that Warde [[Death/Legends|killed]] at during the meeting after [[Gender/Legends|he]] had begun to descend into madness.<ref name="Chronicles" />
